titulo_es: Close a story with personal reflection

texto: Narrating an event, placing it and closing it with a reflection. **Efteråt förstod jag varför** means «Then I understood why». It relates the expression to the purpose of the text. Look at the connectors and reformulate the idea with your own words before you respond. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
